magic_signatures.description: Save-valid marker: '^' (0x5E) with u16 0x0016 at +2. FUN_08023b68 refuses to load unless byte0=='^' and u16 at +2==0x16; FUN_08023b04 stamps bytes [2]=0x16,[3]=0x00 before the 500-byte bulk write; FUN_08023bec stamps [0]=0x5E plus u16 0x16 at init.

fields.name: best_time_00_value
fields.description: Best lap/time ticks for leaderboard slot 0 (14-entry best-time table at save+0x15C). Lower wins; 0 means empty slot.
fields.evidence: FUN_08023d24 reads record (param_2*8+0x15C+save_base) slot 0; FUN_0801c494 compares live race time at param_1+0x1D8+idx*4 against this stored u32 and rewrites it via FUN_08023f3c when the new time is lower or stored==0; bulk-persisted by FUN_08023ab8/FUN_08023a18 (500 B from save base through EEPROM block routines FUN_08098128/FUN_0809830c).

fields.name: best_time_00_class
fields.description: Aux selector byte (vehicle/class id from race state param_1+4) stored with best-time slot 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c494 copies one byte from *(param_1+4) into record byte 4 (local_14) and stores the 8-byte record via FUN_08023f3c at save+0x15C+index*8 (reader FUN_08023d24); baseline 0x00.

fields.name: best_time_00_holder
fields.description: Driver initials holding best-time slot 0 (3 chars, baseline 'WTC').
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c494 copies 3 bytes from DAT_0801c518 (driver-initials buffer) into record bytes 5..7 and stores via FUN_08023f3c at save+0x15C+index*8 (reader FUN_08023d24); baseline reads 'WTC'.

fields.name: best_time_01_value

fields.evidence: Same access path as slot 0 with index 1: FUN_08023d24/FUN_08023f3c address save+0x15C+index*8, so slot 1 lives at save+0x164; update rule (lower-wins, 0==empty) from FUN_0801c494; persisted by FUN_08023ab8/FUN_08023a18.

fields.name: best_time_01_holder
